title: Mexican Sliders
description: A classic Mexican-inspired twist on the traditional burger, topped with a tangy slaw and melted cheese.

ingredients.name: Croatian slaw
ingredients.notes: Spicy, tangy slaw made with shredded cabbage and carrots

ingredients.name: Salsa
ingredients.notes: Fresh, spicy salsa made with diced tomatoes, onions, and jalapenos

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties, about 1 inch thick.
Season the patties with salt and pepper.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Build the sliders by spreading a layer of salsa on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked patty, a slice of cheese, a spoonful of slaw, and finally the top bun.
